title: certkit specification, v1
description: The claim: within `domain`, `guard` implies every conjunct of `safety`. Relations are linear over the rationals, with exact [numerator, denominator] coefficients. This schema constrains shape only -- it cannot tell you whether the relations describe your program, which is the human's job.

name.description: A label for humans. Not load-bearing, but it is covered by the fingerprint.

domain.description: Bounds on the attacker-controlled inputs. Assumed, not proved.

safety.description: The property that must hold. A conjunction: one obligation per element.

safety_index.description: Which safety conjunct a single reconstructed obligation refutes.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of this object with `fingerprint` removed. Detects drift; it is NOT a defence against a forger who controls the spec.

rational.description: An exact rational as [numerator, denominator]; a bare integer is also accepted. The denominator must not be zero.

atom.description: A linear relation in canonical form: sum(coeff*var) + const <= 0, or < 0 when strict.
